text.body: || śukarahasyopaniṣat || oṃ saha nāvavatu || saha nau bhunaktu || saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai || tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || athāto rahasyopaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 1 || devarṣayo brahmāṇaṃ sampūjya praṇipatya papracachurbhagavannasmākaṃ rahasyopaniṣadaṃ brūhīti || 2 || so'bravīt purā vyāso mahātejāḥ sarvavedataponidhiḥ | praṇipatya śivaṃ sāmbaṃ kṛtāñjaliruvāca || 3 || śrīvedavyāsa uvāca devadeva mahāprājña pāśacchedadṛḍhavrata | śukasya mama putrasya vedasaṃskārakarmaṇi || 4 || brahmopadeśakālo'yamidānīṃ samupasthitaḥ | brahmopadeśaḥ kartavyo bhavatādya jagadguro || 5 || īśvara uvāca mayopadiṣṭe kaivalye sākṣādbrahmaṇi śāśvate | vihāya putro nirvedātprakāśaṃ yāsyati svayam || 6 || śrīvedavyāsa uvāca yathā tathā vā bhavatu hyupanāyanakarmaṇi | upadiṣṭe mama sute brahmaṇi tvatprasādataḥ || 7 || sarvajño bhavatu kṣipraṃ mama putro maheśvara | tava prasādasampanno labhenmuktiṃ caturvidhām || 8 || tacchrutvā vyāsavacanaṃ sarvadevarṣisaṃsadi | upadeṣṭuṃ sthitaḥ śambhuḥ sāmbo divyāsane mudā || 9 || kṛtakṛtyaḥ śukastatra samāgatya subhaktimān | tasmātsa praṇavaṃ labdhvā punarityabravīcchivam || 10 || śrīśuka uvāca devādideva sarvajña saccidānandalakṣaṇa | umāramaṇa bhūteśa prasīda karuṇānidhe || 11 || upadiṣṭaṃ parabrahma praṇavāntargataṃ param | tattvamasyādivākyānāṃ prajñādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 12 || śrotumicchāmi tattvena ṣaḍaṅgāni yathākramam | vaktavyāni rahasyāni kṛpayādya sadāśiva || 13 || śrīsadāśiva uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña śuka jñānanidhe mune | praṣṭavyaṃ tu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ rahasyaṃ vedagarbhitam || 14 || rahasyopaniṣannāmnā saṣaḍaṅgamihocyate | yasya vijñānamātreṇa mokṣaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ || 15 || aṅgahīnāni vākyāni gururnopadiśetpunaḥ | saṣaḍaṅgānyupadiśenmahāvākyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 16 || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ yathopaniṣadaḥ śiraḥ | iyaṃ rahasyopaniṣadattathopaniṣadāṃ śiraḥ || 17 || rahasyopaniṣadbrahma dhyātaṃ yena vipaścitā | tīrthairmantraiḥ śrutairjapyaistasya kiṃ puṇyahetubhiḥ || 18 || vākyārthasya vicāreṇa yadāpnoti śaracchatam | ekavārajapenaiva ṛṣyādidhyānataśca yat || 19 || oṃ asya śrīmahāvākyamahāmantrasya haṃsa ṛṣiḥ | avyaktagāyatrī chandaḥ | paramahaṃso devatā | haṃ bījam | saḥ śaktiḥ | so'haṃ kīlakam | mama paramahaṃsaprītyarthe mahāvākyajape viniyogaḥ | satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | nityānando brahma tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | nityānandamayaṃ brahma madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | yo vai bhūmā anāmikābhyāṃ hum | yo vai bhūmādhipatiḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma hṛdayāya namaḥ | nityānando brahma śirase svāhā | nityānandamayaṃ brahma śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | yo vai bhūmā kavacāya hum | yo vai bhūmādhipatiḥ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma astrāya phaṭ | bhūrbhuvaḥsuvaromiti digbandhaḥ || 20 || dhyānam | nityānandaṃ paramasukhadaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamūrtiṃ viśvātītaṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ tattvamasyādilakṣyam | ekaṃ nityaṃ vimalamacalaṃ sarvadhīsākṣibhūtaṃ bhāvātītaṃ triguṇarahitaṃ sadguruṃ taṃ namāmi || 21 || atha mahāvākyāni catvāri | yathā | oṃ prajñānaṃ brahma || 1 || oṃ ahaṃ brahmāsmi || 2 || oṃ tattvamasi || 3 || oṃ ayamātmā brahma || 4 || tattvamasītyabhedavācakamidaṃ ye japanti te śivassāyujyamuktibhājo bhavanti || 22 || tatpadamahāmantrasya paramahaṃsaḥ ṛṣiḥ | avyaktagāyatrī chandaḥ | paramahaṃso devatā | haṃ bījam | saḥ śaktiḥ | so'haṃ kīlakam | mama sāyujyamuktyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | tatpuruṣāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | īśānāya tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | aghorāya madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | sadyojātāya anāmikābhyāṃ hum | vāmadevāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | tatpuruṣeśānāghorasadyojātavāmadevebhyo namaḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | bhūrbhuvaḥsuvaromiti digbandhaḥ || 23 || dhyānam | jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyāditītaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ muktamapyavyayaṃ ca | satyaṃ jñānaṃ saccidānandarūpaṃ dhyāyedevaṃ tanmaho bhrājamānam || 24 || tvaṃpada mahāmantrasya viṣṇurṛṣiḥ | gāyatrī chandaḥ | paramātmā devatā | aiṃ bījam | klīṃ śaktiḥ | sauḥ kīlakam | mama muktyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | vāsudevāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | saṅkarṣaṇāya tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | pradyumnāya madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | aniruddhāya anāmikābhyāṃ hum | vāsudevāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhebhyaḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | bhūrbhuvaḥsuvaromiti digbandhaḥ || 25 || dhyānam | jīvatvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvatrākhaṇḍavigraham | cittāhaṅkārayantāraṃ jīvākhyaṃ tvaṃ padaṃ bhaje || 26 || asipadamahāmantrasya mana ṛṣiḥ | gāyatrī chandaḥ | ardhanārīśvaro devatā | avyaktādirbījam | nṛsiṃhaḥ śaktiḥ | paramātmā kīlakam | jīvabrahmaikyārthe jape viniyogaḥ | pṛthvīdvyaṇukāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | abdvyaṇukāya tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | tejodvyaṇukāya madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | vāyudvyaṇukāya anāmikābhyaṃ hum | ākāśadvyaṇukāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśadvyaṇukebhyaḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | bhūrbhuvaḥsuvaromiti digbandhaḥ || 27 || dhyānam | jīvo brahmeti vākyārthaṃ yāvadasti manaḥsthitiḥ | aikyaṃ tattvaṃ laye kurvandhyāyedasipadaṃ sadā || 28 || evaṃ mahāvākyaṣaḍaṅgānyuktāni || 29 || atha rahasyopaniṣadvibhāgaśo vākyārthaślokāḥ procyante || 30 || yenekṣate śṛṇotīdaṃ jighrati vyākaroti ca | svādvasvādu vijānāti tatprajñānamudīritam || 31 || caturmukhendradeveṣu manuṣyāśvagavādiṣu | caitanyamekaṃ brahmātaḥ prajñānaṃ brahma mayyapi || 32 || paripūrṇaḥ parātmāsmindehe vidyādhikāriṇi | buddheḥ sākṣitayā sthitvā sphurannahamitīryate || 33 || svataḥ pūrṇaḥ parātmātra brahmaśabdena varṇitaḥ | asmītyaikyaparāmarśastena brahma bhavāmyaham || 34 || ekamevādvitīyaṃ sannāmarūpavivarjitam | sṛṣṭeḥ purādhunāpyasya tādṛktvaṃ taditīryate || 35 || śroturdehendriyātītaṃ vastvatra tvaṃpaderitam | ekatā grāhyate'sīti tadaikyamanubhūyatām || 36 || svaprakāśāparokṣatvamayamityuktito matam | ahaṅkārādidehāntaṃ pratyagātmeti gīyate || 37 || dṛśyamānasya sarvasya jagatastattvamīryate | brahmaśabdena tadbrahma svaprakāśātmarūpakam || 38 || anātmadṛṣṭeravivekanidrāmahaṃ mama svapnagatiṃ gato'ham | svarūpasūrye'bhyudite sphuṭoktergurormahāvākyapadaiḥ prabuddhaḥ || 39 || vācyaṃ lakṣyamiti dvidhārthasaraṇīvācyasya hi tvaṃpade vācyaṃ bhautikamindriyādirapi yallakṣyaṃ tvamarthaśca saḥ | vācyaṃ tatpadamīśatākṛtamatirlakṣyaṃ tu saccitsukhānandabrahma tadartha eṣa ca tayoraikyaṃ tvasīdaṃ padam || 40 || tvamiti taditi kārye kāraṇe satyupādhau dvitayamitarathaikaṃ saccidānandarūpam | ubhayavacanahetū deśakālau ca hitvā jagati bhavati soyaṃ devadatto yathaikaḥ || 41 || kāryopādhirayaṃ jīvaḥ kāraṇopādhirīśvaraḥ | kāryakāraṇatāṃ hitvā pūrṇabodho'vaśiṣyate || 42 || śravaṇaṃ tu guroḥ pūrvaṃ mananaṃ tadanantaram | nididhyāsanamityetatpūrṇabodhasya kāraṇam || 43 || anyavidyāparijñānamavaśyaṃ naśvaraṃ bhavet | brahmavidyāparijñānaṃ brahmaprāptikaraṃ sthitam || 44 || mahāvākyānyupadiśetsaṣaḍaṅgāni deśikaḥ | kevalaṃ na hi vākyāni brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā || 45 || īśvara uvāca | evamuktvā muniśreṣṭha rahasyopaniṣacchuka | mayā pitrānunītena vyāsena brahmavādinā || 46 || tato brahmopadiṣṭaṃ vai saccidānandalakṣaṇam | jīvanmuktaḥ sadā dhyāyannityastvaṃ vihariṣyasi || 47 || yo vedādau svaraḥ prokto vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ paraḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || 48 || upadiṣṭaḥ śiveneti jagattanmayatāṃ gataḥ | utthāya praṇipatyeśaṃ tyaktāśeṣaparigrahaḥ || 49 || parabrahmapayorāśau plavanniva yayau tadā | pravrajantaṃ tamālokya kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ || 50 || anuvrajannājuhāva putraviśleṣakātaraḥ | pratinedustadā sarve jagatsthāvarajaṅgamāḥ || 51 || tacchrutvā sakalākāraṃ vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | putreṇa sahitaḥ prītyā parānandamupeyivān || 52 || yo rahasyopaniṣadamadhīte gurvanugrahāt | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sākṣātkaivalyamaśnute sākṣātkaivalyamaśnuta ityupaniṣat || 53 || oṃ saha nāvavatu || saha nau bhunaktu || saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai || tejasvinādhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || || iti śukarahasyopaniṣatsamāptā ||
